children: Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) is scaling autonomous tech—from Austin Cybercab rollouts and Netherlands FSD approval to Optimus robot parts and a Europe-spec Semi—while reporting strong deliveries and margins, rising U.S. EV share, export growth and scrutiny over safety and certifications.
Previous Week Recap
Cybercabs Rollout And Probe

: Tesla began limited Austin rollouts of two-seat, wheel-less Cybercabs. Texas shows 45 Cybercabs among 420 autonomous vehicles. NHTSA is probing whether up to 1,000 Cybercabs met safety certification.
Q2 Deliveries And Margins
: TSLA Q2 deliveries 480,126 vehicles (467,762 Model 3/Y). Automotive gross margin 16.3%. Capex $5.8B. Free cash flow roughly -$1.1B.
Semi Software Revenue Outlook
: Morgan Stanley projects Tesla Semi software revenue $12k–$18k per truck monthly, sees ~$17B long-term autonomous-trucking software market by 2040, expects Semi production ramp in 2027.
U.S. EV Market Share Rise
: Tesla (TSLA) held a 52% U.S. EV market share in Jan–Aug 2026, up from 43% in Jan–Aug 2025, Motor Intelligence says; shift follows reduced EV activity by legacy automakers.
Europe-Spec Semi Unveiling
: Tesla (TSLA) will unveil a Europe-spec Semi at IAA Hanover: up to 550 km range (40t), ~9,100 kg vehicle mass, 25 kW PTO, regen via Megachargers (up to 800 kW), route charging; production 2026.
Optimus Components Order
: Tesla (TSLA) ordered about 5,000 Optimus humanoid robot components, moving from prototypes to repeatable factory output; production lines set for Fremont as Tesla readies for volume manufacturing.
FSD Approved In Netherlands
: Netherlands approved Tesla Full Self-Driving (FSD) in April. EU to vote in October on continent-wide FSD adoption, a decision that will affect TSLA deployment across member states.
Shanghai Exports Rise
: Tesla (TSLA) shipped 36,119 vehicles from its Shanghai plant in August, a 38.7% year-over-year rise in Shanghai exports.
Autopilot Not Involved Crash
: Tesla (TSLA): CEO Elon Musk said Autopilot wasn’t involved in a fatal NYC Model Y crash with scaffolding and claimed the collision wouldn’t have happened if Autopilot had been engaged.
Safety Review Of Autopilot

: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi asked U.S. transport regulators to review Tesla (TSLA) Autopilot and Full Self-Driving safety, citing videos of disengaged drivers and potential driver-monitoring weaknesses.
